objects.name: Analytic 1802
objects.description: For Android, detect Replication Through Removable Media by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: File with binary signature (.apk, .dex, .so, .sh) written to app storage or /data/local/tmp/ from USB-mounted path or external storage within $USBInstallWindow$]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [Application installed with install_source=adb or install_source=sideload from USB-connected host within $USBInstallWindow$ of USB mode change]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
